entries.message: traceql: scalar-filter RHS must be a literal, got %T
entries.rationale: internal invariant: lowerScalarFilter only dispatches here when isBareStatic(sf.RHS) holds, so lowerScalarExpr(sf.RHS) always resolves via the Static case to a chplan.Expr; the type-assert failure is unreachable at this call site.

entries.message: traceql: scalar-filter LHS must aggregate to a series (count() / sum(...) / avg(...) / min(...) / max(...)), got %T
